channel.title: Mothfire Labs — Blog
channel.description: Mothfire Labs builds AI that understands what makes work exceptional — and keeps refining until it gets there.

item.title: What Refinement Takes
item.description: Before building anything, we read what’s known about AI that improves its own work. Refinement works when feedback can be checked. To go further, the judge, the loop, and the cost all have to get better.

item.title: Beyond Generation. Toward Mastery.
item.description: Our research vision — AI systems that understand what makes work exceptional, and deliberately improve their creations until they meet demanding standards of quality.
